data.title: Invitation to personal appearance – residence permit extension (Landesamt für Einwanderung Muster)
data.summary: The Landesamt für Einwanderung Muster invites Nora Musterova to a personal appearance on 15 October 2026 at 10:45 to process her application of 1 September 2026 for an extension of her residence permit (Aufenthaltserlaubnis).
data.explanation: This is an appointment letter from the immigration office about your residence permit extension application. You must attend in person on the date and time given, bringing your passport, employer certificate, rental contract and a biometric photo. Your current Fiktionsbescheinigung stays valid until the office decides. If you cannot attend, contact the office beforehand using the phone number or email on the letter to reschedule, as missing it could delay your case.
